worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.summary: Turns its gears into Torque or Overdrive: both split the same total gain between Attack and Speed, and shifting into the other gear replaces this move's current contribution and resets its timer. The gain lasts only for a window and is taken back when it ends or is cleared.
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.use.0: Become a different machine at the start of a fight
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.use.1: Gain speed before running someone down
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.use.2: Shift before a closing enemy arrives
The selected gear raises Attack by %1$s stages and Speed by %2$s stages, each limited by the +6 stage cap.

Shifting into the other gear replaces this move's current contribution and resets its timer; the same gear already active cannot be shifted into again. The gain lasts only for a window and is taken back when it ends or is cleared, without touching Attack or Speed stages from other sources.
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.timing: Self-targeted; wind-up %1$s, recovery %2$s, cost %3$s PP, cooldown %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.preference.g: Both gears distribute the same total gain between Attack and Speed. Torque favors Attack; Overdrive favors Speed. Both gain one extra Attack stage at level 50. Shifting into the other gear replaces this move's contribution and resets its timer; the same gear already active cannot be shifted into again.
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.preference.a: Consider shifting when a threat is within this distance; larger prepares earlier and risks interruption.
Stop shifting when a threat is closer than this; fall back to the normal order instead of standing still to buff.
